Tucking the note into his coat, he climbed back to his lamp, lit it against the dusk, and for the first time in years, smiled.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一个还没醒来的巨人。街灯昏黄，照着空荡的马路，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，留下短暂的声响。早点铺的卷帘门缓缓升起，蒸汽在冷空气里升腾。清洁工挥动扫帚，沙沙声格外清晰。高楼的窗大多黑着，只有零星几盏灯亮着，不知是谁彻夜未眠。天边泛起淡淡的青灰，黎明正悄悄逼近。这一刻，城市安静得几乎听得见自己的心跳，仿佛在为新的一天积蓄力量。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller copy of itself, like looking into two mirrors facing each other.\n• You always need a stopping point, so it doesn't go on forever — like knowing when to stop counting down.\n• Think of nesting dolls: you open one, find a smaller one inside, and keep going until you reach the tiniest doll."}
